news.title: LEGiON Platforms beta releases Plundur.io in 250+ countries
news.article: (LEGiON Platforms) - LEGiON Platforms, a 3D technology and web ecosystem company, has announced the global launch of its latest game, Plundur.io. The 3D multiplayer pirate-themed survival game is now available to play in more than 250 countries through web browsers via the link https://plundur.io/. Plundur.io is a unique and thrilling gaming experience that immerses players in the open seas as they take on the role of a pirate. Players must navigate the seas, scavenge for treasure, and battle other players to survive. The game features stunning 3D graphics and multiple game modes, including a free-for-all battle royale mode and a team-based capture the flag mode, allowing players to engage in fast-paced and action-packed battles. This new release marks a significant milestone for LEGiON Platforms, as it is the company's first game to be launched in such a large number of countries. The launch of Plundur.io has been met with excitement from both players and industry experts. Many have praised the game's graphics and immersive gameplay, calling it a "must-play" for fans of pirate-themed games. Plundur.io is now available to play for free in web browsers via the link https://plundur.io/. With its global launch, players from all over the world can now set sail and join the pirate adventure. LEGiON Platforms has also announced plans to continue to support the game with new updates and features in the future.  P
